title: Best Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend
excerpt: Memorial Day weekend marks the unofficial start of summer in the NC High Country, and Boone is absolutely buzzing with energy right now. Whether you're visiting for the first time or quietly wondering what it might feel like to live here full-time, this weekend is one of the best possible introductions to mountain life.
